strings.login.redirect.title: Opening Kakao
strings.login.redirect.body: You'll come back to Aroom after signing in.
strings.login.cancelled.title: Sign-in was canceled
strings.login.cancelled.body: You can try again whenever you like.
strings.login.error.title: Couldn't sign you in
strings.login.error.body: Try again in a moment, or choose another method.
strings.login.email.title: Enter your email address
strings.login.email.invalid: Check the format of the email address.
strings.login.code.title: Enter the code we emailed you
strings.login.code.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. You can also tap the link in the email.
strings.login.code.label: Verification code
strings.login.code.wrong: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
strings.login.code.expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
strings.login.code.rate: Too many attempts. Try again in {m} minutes.
strings.login.quick.title: DEV · Enter with a test account
strings.login.signup.link: New here? Create an account with a password
strings.login.signup.title: Create your account
strings.login.pw.label: Password
strings.login.signup.terms: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy (14 or older)
strings.login.signup.sent.title: We sent a confirmation email
strings.login.signup.sent.body: Tap the link in the email we sent to {email} to finish signing up.
strings.login.mail.spam: If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder or resend in a minute.
strings.login.pw.title: Enter your password
strings.login.pw.useCode: Sign in with a code instead
strings.login.pw.wrong: That password isn't right. Try again or sign in with a code.
strings.login.pw.rate: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 10 minutes, or sign in with a code now.
strings.login.reset.title: Let's reset your password
strings.login.reset.body: We'll send a reset code and link to your sign-up email.
strings.login.reset.sent.title: Reset email sent
strings.login.reset.sent.body: We sent a 6-digit code and a link to {email}. Tap the link or enter the code.
strings.login.reset.code.title: Enter the reset code
strings.login.pw.new.title: Create a new password
strings.login.apple.sheetNote: Apple shows this sheet. Mopiru never receives or stores your password; it only gets the sign-in result.
strings.onb.pw.title: Create an app password
strings.onb.pw.body: We'll ask for it to confirm it's you before important actions like deleting your account. It's separate from your Apple or Kakao password.
